correctness.rationale: With m unmatched vertices all proposals choose distinct neighbors independently. Ordered disjoint mutual-pair patterns give E(C_m)_r=(m)_{2r}/[2^r(m−1)^{2r}], hence mean removed m/(m−1) and variance 2m(m−2)^2/(m−1)^3. The uniform probability of at least one pair controls geometric state residence. The exact stopped-martingale identity N_n=T_n+A_n+M_T, where A_n=O_L2(log n), gives E T_n=n+O(log n), Var T_n=2n+O(sqrt n log n), and a martingale CLT yields (T_n−n)/sqrt(2n)⇒N(0,1). The bounded-away-from-terminal quadratic variation gives the functional Brownian law. Independent exhaustive enumeration of each loop-free proposal mapping m=2..6 recovered the exact mean/variance. Martingale infinite limits rely on the analytic bounds.
